comments.body: Ephemeral COPR build failed. @containers/packit-build please check.

RPM builds on Raw Hide fail because it's using Go 1.27 (rc2 as I write this), and the needed https://go-review.googlesource.com/c/net/+/776180 didn't land in golang.org/x/net until its 0.55 release, while this branch uses 0.54.

We already have v1.45.0 released so why we would want to patch v1.44?
Do we not plan to follow the same supported release branches as on podman? podman 5.8 and latest release.
So I think for buildah that means supported release is 1.43 and latest == 1.45 at the moment.

Do we want to do things differently here? cc @mheon
I think we need to have a wider discussion about support policy on all podman container tools repos
I would like us to document a policy somewhere that states how far back we support, especially regarding CVEs.
